verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB documents turning any SQL query into a monitored rule with operator, threshold, interval and severity (docs-21), and attaching reusable Slack or HTTP webhook destinations so a matching condition triggers an outbound action (docs-22). Materialized views also run transformations automatically on insert events (docs-34, docs-36). missing for 10: actions beyond notifications/webhooks (e.g., running SQL or jobs as a rule action), true event-driven triggers rather than interval-polled conditions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
